This role focuses on interaction design, information architecture, workflow logic, and UI/UX development for systems such as CRM, ERP, CMS, web calculators, service portals, and partner-facing tools.

Working closely with Business Analysts, developers, and cross-functional stakeholders, this position bridges business intent and technical execution—defining user flows, prototypes, and design specifications that guide high-quality development. Tools such as Figma, Adobe XD, and HTML/CSS prototypes are used to visualize and validate design concepts.

- Design user flows, layouts, and interface components for digital applications.
- Convert business and BA-consolidated requirements into clear interaction flows and logic.

＊Benchmarking and Design Research
- Research best-in-class UX patterns and modern interaction models.
- Analyze CRM, ERP, SaaS, and enterprise application examples to understand workflow logic.

＊Design System and Specification
- Maintain a consistent design system with reusable components and style guidelines.
- Create UI specifications and component documentation that developers can directly implement.
- Build mockups using CSS frameworks or HTML/CSS when necessary for demonstration.

＊Developer Collaboration and Handoff
- Work closely with developers to ensure accurate implementation of UI/UX designs.
- Provide detailed design specs, interaction documents, and style references.
- Conduct clarifications and review sessions to ensure development feasibility and fidelity.

＊Usability Testing and Iteration
- Support usability testing and collect feedback from users.
- Iterate designs based on test results and evolving requirements.
- Contribute to enhancing workflow efficiency and handoff processes.
